svg.title: Smooth Linear Approach
svg.desc: A stylized Audacity-like waveform for the PPS-kit smooth-linear source mode: uninterrupted noise grows smoothly from far and quiet to near and loud.

g.font-family: Aptos, Noto Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
g.text: Smooth noise with one rising approach envelope.
